Anthropic says new defences cut distillation of Claude reasoning 10-fold

Anthropic says reasoning tokens extractable from Claude fell 10 to 100 times after new classifiers and account limits, and it names Zhipu's GLM-5.3 as a distillation target.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-distillation-defenses/

Janas runs 80-billion-parameter models on a laptop by streaming experts from SSD
https://theaipost.net/story/find-janas-llm-ssd-experts/

TerminalHorizon fine-tune lifts a 27B model to 55.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.0
https://theaipost.net/story/find-terminalhorizon-27b/

Nikkei says NTT is near a deal for Anthropic's first Japan data centre

Nikkei Asia reports, citing unnamed sources, that NTT Data could spend $6.3 billion on an Osaka facility for Anthropic, with a partial opening expected by 2028.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nikkei-ntt-anthropic-osaka/

AWS puts OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol, Luna and Astra on Bedrock for five Asian regions

AWS says developers in Singapore, Jakarta, Thailand, Malaysia and Taipei can call GPT-6 models through Bedrock, where each output token uses up 10 tokens of quota.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aws-bedrock-gpt6-asia/

Artificial Analysis launches AA-3D, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 on top
https://theaipost.net/story/find-aa-3d-benchmark/

Cursor folds into The X Subscription, with Grok models at twice the usage

Cursor says its plans now sit inside The X Subscription, which runs from a free tier to $200 a month, and third-party models in Cursor move to API pricing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-x-subscription-cursor/
